coverage_manifest.coverage_decision: All four pages were text-mapped and rendered. Both main-text figures were visually inspected and reconciled. There are no tables, formal algorithms/workflows, appendices, or supplements in the supplied file.
omissions: Bibliographic entries were not atomized as primary evidence. They are handled by the separate reference task queue.
Secondary background claims in the Introduction and Discussion were not converted into primary-study findings unless they were the authors own case-level interpretation.

visual_reconciliation.figure_1_note: Radiograph visually matches the SEA summary: no obvious periapical radiolucency and an ill-defined radiotransparent area around the pulpal chamber as described by the source.
visual_reconciliation.figure_2_note: Clinical photograph visibly shows the open post-extraction socket and inflamed tissue described in the caption. The image does not identify the causative organism.

reference_processing.note: A queue exists, but every top-level reference task remains unchecked. The queue is not treated as completed reference processing.
